instruction: A cinematic wedding photograph with a warm, romantic tone, captured in a full-length, eye-level shot. In an outdoor grassy field with trees and a rustic building in the background, the bride in a white wedding dress (R1) and the groom in a beige suit (R2) embrace closely in front of a white vintage car. The bride (R1), positioned on the left, wraps her arm around the groom's neck while holding a bouquet of white flowers. The groom (R2), standing on the right, wraps his arms around her waist as they share an intimate kiss. Soft, warm natural daylight illuminates the scene, casting gentle shadows on the grass.
